description: Check an expense report against your company's expense policy before it is approved or paid. Send the expense lines (date, category, amount, receipt attached or not) and your policy: per-category limits per line and per day, categories that always need a receipt, and the amount from which any line needs a receipt (the IRS accountable-plan rule uses 75). Get back every breach (over the per-line limit, over the daily limit, missing receipt) with the line, the limit and the amount over, the total over policy without double counting, the amount claimed without receipts, and the categories your policy does not cover. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/expense-policy-check). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

label.description: Optional label for the report, e.g. 'March trip' (your own text, echoed; no names of people needed).

limits.description: Optional: policy rows per category (up to 50), each with per_item_max, per_day_max and/or receipt_always.

category.description: Expense category, e.g. 'meals', 'lodging' (matched without regard to case or extra spaces).

per_day_max.description: Optional: most allowed for this category on one date, all lines added up.

per_item_max.description: Optional: most allowed on one line of this category (0 = not reimbursable).

receipt_always.description: Optional: true when this category needs a receipt at any amount (lodging under the IRS rule).

amount.description: Amount claimed (above 0, in the report's currency).

category.description: Expense category, e.g. 'meals', 'lodging' (matched without regard to case or extra spaces).

date.description: Date the expense was incurred, YYYY-MM-DD (daily limits count per date).

receipt.description: true when a receipt is attached for this line.

ref.description: Optional line reference or memo (your own text, up to 6 digits in a row; echoed).

receipt_required_from.description: Optional: any line of this amount or more needs a receipt (IRS accountable-plan rule: 75).
